name: dik.inputsystem
description: A reusable layer on top of Unity's Input System, modelled on Unreal Engine 5 Enhanced Input. It adds prioritised Input Mapping Contexts, separate UI and Gameplay input layers, automatic device pairing and hot-swap, rebinding that is saved between sessions, and command routing that is the same offline and with any netcode (client sends, server processes).

samples.description: Character driven by DikInputReceiver, pause flow with UI/Gameplay isolation, device display and rebind button.
Example IInputNetworkBridge for Unity Netcode for GameObjects (requires com.unity.netcode.gameobjects).
